scenario_name: Dubai surplus to Abu Dhabi shortage
rationale: DXB has 500 available against about 200 forecast units; AUH has 100 available against about 350 forecast units.
guardrail: Keep at least DXB 30-day forecast coverage after the transfer; transfer range 150-180 units.

guardrail: Do not dispatch a dedicated inter-emirate transfer for a 15-unit low-margin shortage.

guardrail: Retain enough stock for the 30-day forecast and open reservations before reducing safety stock.
